metadata.title: USDJPY GHL+DC H1 Parent
metadata.notes: Clean USDJPY H1 translation of the Gann High Low plus Donchian breakout parent. XAU-optimized values and time filters are not inherited. FX quote-currency PnL is converted from JPY to USD and IC Markets lot economics are fixed execution assumptions.

spec.causal_story: On USDJPY H1, Gann High Low defines a transparent trend-state flip. Donchian confirmation requires price to break the stored channel extreme soon after the flip. Positions exit on the opposite Gann state close or an explicit ATR stop, with next-executable MT5 fills and JPY-denominated PnL converted to USD.

direct_translation: Gann High Low state from SMA(high, HPeriod) and SMA(low, LPeriod)
maximum bars allowed between Gann cross and Donchian confirmation
transparent_approximations: ATR initial stop is added because the Pine source had no hard stop and StrategyLab needs bounded risk for fixed-risk sizing.

MT5 proxy execution arms stop orders only after a completed Gann setup bar, fills from the following bar using bid OHLC plus explicit spread and gap-aware prices, activates the initial stop only after entry, and executes Gann market exits at the following bar open.
USDJPY gross PnL and stop risk are first calculated in JPY and converted to USD using the executable price; commission is modeled as 3.5 USD per standard lot per side.
